description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the HttpPushFactory class, specifically testing its request creation, authentication, proxy configuration, and error handling capabilities within an HTTP push messaging context.

classes.name: HttpPushFactoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for HttpPushFactory, testing request creation, authentication, proxy configuration, and error handling.

methods.name: appendPathToUri
methods.description: Tests appending a path to the URI in HttpPushFactory's request.

methods.name: basicAuth
methods.description: Verifies that basic authentication headers are correctly included when credentials are in the URI.

methods.name: withHttpProxyConfig
methods.description: Tests proxy configuration and verifies rejection when proxy targets an unreachable host.

methods.name: handleFailure
methods.description: Tests request handling when in-flight requests are killed or when the server becomes unavailable.

methods.name: newBinding
methods.description: Sets up a mock HTTP server binding for testing.

methods.name: shutdownAllServerStreams
methods.description: Triggers shutdown of the server streams.

methods.name: newSourceSinkQueues
methods.description: Creates source and sink queues for testing request flow.

methods.name: pullResponse
methods.description: Helper to pull response from sink queue.

methods.name: createHttpPushConnection
methods.description: Creates a connection object for an HTTP push test scenario.

methods.name: getEnabledProxyConfig
methods.description: Returns a proxy configuration pointing to the test server binding.
